name: Theme: Welcome, New Cruisers!
description: We'll be holding events specifically designed to make our first-time JoCo Cruisers feel welcome and to help them ease into the swing of things. Make a particular effort on this day to seek out new attendees and help show them what a great decision they've made by joining us!

name: Half Moon/Stuyvesant Room Unavailable Until 10:30 pm
Info Desk Hours
description:
If you need information, well heck we have information! Come here for any JoCo Cruise-related questions or issues you may have.

If you have questions or problems relating to the ship—your cabin, billing, etc—please go to the ship’s Guest Services Desk, located on the opposite side of the Atrium on Deck 1.

name: Pick up badges and lanyards
description: Please come to the Lido Pool Area once you board to pick up your badges and lanyards. These will function as nametags, you can add your pronoun information, and will be required for entry to the Main Concert events that correspond to your assigned team (Red or Gold).

name: Twit-arr Help Desk Hours
description: Our team will be on hand to help answer any support questions you may have.

name: Boarding begins (approximately)
description: The Nieuw Amsterdam will begin boarding at approximately 12 noon. (Might be a little earlier, might be a little later; boarding can only begin after the ship reaches "zero count"—i.e. all previous passengers are officially off the ship—and US Customs has fully cleared the ship. So the actual boarding start time can vary.

name: High Score is open - All Ages
description: High Score, the ship's arcade, is open daily from 1 pm to 11 pm. All ages are welcome at all times. Pinball, multicades, Skeeball, and more!

name: Kids Club registration
description: HAL offers their Kids Club youth activities program for kids and teens 3-17 years old. See the HAL Kids Club page for details. Note that operating hours for JoCo Cruise are different than those listed on that page.

name: Safety Check-in at your muster station 1 pm - 3:30 pm
description: You must check in at your muster station between 1 pm - 3:30 pm. (Your muster station is listed on your stateroom keycard.) You can view the safety procedures video on HAL's Navigator app or on your stateroom TV.

name: Speed Meeting
description:
Are you anxious about being on a big boat with a bunch of strangers? What if they WEREN'T strangers - but the friends in this friendSHIP! FRIENDSHIP ASSEMBLE!

Speed Meeting is a facilitated and casually structured event that allows you to cross that barrier and meet new people!

This is a drop-in, drop-out event. Come whenever you can, leave when you need to!

name: Morimoto by Sea Unavailable Until 2:00 pm
Orientation
description: A basic walkthrough of the main logistics of JoCo Cruise, and we'll answer as many of your questions as we possibly can. Show up when you can, leave when you wish. Recommended for new JoCo Cruisers, but open to everyone.

name: Shadow Cruise Tech Time! Check in about your Shadow Event Tech Needs.
description: The Shadow Cruise Production Team will be on the back deck answering any questions you have about your scheduled shadow events.

name: Sail Away Reception and Dance Party
description: Come up topside and watch the land go bye-bye! The mysterious DJ Krustoid will play us out by the Sea View Pool.

name: All-helper Meeting
description: All helpers, please attend this brief Day 1 meeting with Cruise Mom Thera.

name: Collaborative Mural Creation Begins
description:
All are welcome in this collaborative art piece to create a giant wall mural over the course of the cruise. Each day we'll add more pages onto the mural, creating a larger and more robust canvas for everyone to build on and add to their previous day's work. At the end of the cruise, we'll have a final, Glorious (we hope) product! Artists and non artists are invited to come add their creativity to this project!

The mural is located on the forward wall of the Atrium on Deck 2.

name: Ship-wide Chess Match Begins
description: Which team is the best at strategy? Find out by throwing your lot in as the two teams of JoCo match wits in an epic series of chess matches! Add your brainpower to the match to out think your fellow cruisers. Be careful on your move though! Each player only gets ONE move per day in these games!

name: Main Concert (Gold Team) - Opening Night Concert with the Cruise Pals
Kids Club operating hours
description: HAL offers their Kids Club youth activities program for kids and teens 3-17 years old. See the HAL Kids Club page for details. Note that operating hours for JoCo Cruise are different than those listed on that page.

name: Console Gaming Grand Opening
description: Stop by and see what video gaming has to offer this year! World 9 Gaming staff are here all week to help you relive your childhood with games new and old. Come get an introduction to the game library and learn about our scheduled events and meet ups.

name: Main Concert (Red Team) - Opening Night Concert with the Cruise Pals
Nighttime Quiet Zone
description: The starboard side of the Lido Marketplace will be designated the "quiet side" after 9 pm. Other than at the designated 24/7 gaming tables in the aft section, no gaming, no meetings, no loud noises, please. Take yer excessive noise over to the port side, please—or to the back deck, where the late-night pizza is!

name: Good Morning, JoCo
description:
If there were a liiitle tiiiny bayyyybeee Jonathan Coulton who was just sleeping sooo soundly, "Good Morning, JoCo" is what you would say to wake him up, so he could cheerfully start his day trying to escape from the terrarium where you keep him next to a scale model of the Gowanus Canal.

"Good Morning, JoCo" is ALSO a daily live-to-tape late-night-format morning show filmed in the Rolling Stone Lounge. The late night format comes from filming it right after the main concert each evening, which is later at night.

So listen here, join your hosts River Butcher and Daphne Always and their surprise guests—and their planned guests like StormCenter5 Host Storm DiCostanzo.

Come to our live taping for blue jokes, stupid props, jargon related to television production that may or may or not be necessary, reshoots, people wearing gnome hats, and adult themes. We aren't checking ids, but don't yell at us if someone drops a swear that's related to a complex topic you're not ready to explain to an audience member in your charge.

And catch the finished show the next morning! Presented in glorious 1080p at a blistering 3,000 kbps, Good Morning JoCo is a PG-ish delight for the whole family when viewed in your stateroom.

name: Tabletop RPG Jamboree!
description: Calling all TTRPG enthusiasts! We're all gonna be on a boat for a lot of hours, and what better way to while those away than to scheme, trick, murder and rampage through a (hopefully) fictional adventure?! The Tabletop Jamboree is a meetup where all TTRPG lovers can meet one another and set up games to play throughout the cruise. We've set up this time and space for everyone looking to RUN a campaign to pitch their session to potential victims players!. If you are looking to GM a campaign and want to get players, come to this! If you are a player and would love to take part in a TTRPG, come hear some pitches and join up!

name: Bar Trek (Bar Crawl)
description:
Lay in a course for the Goodtime System, Warp Factor FUN! (Ugh, we already apologize for all this.)

Four drinks, four bars (Crow's Nest Bar, Lido Pool Bar, Ocean Bar and Billboard Onboard), lots of people making friends. Hop, hop, hop, hop! Sign up via any bartender or bar server, or at the ship's Guest Services Desk. (This event is run by the ship's staff and costs a $29 surcharge plus 18% service charges, which will be charged to your onboard account)

name: Lights off for stargazing
description:
We have the ship turn off the lights overhead and clear away the deck chairs up here each night from 10 pm to 12 am, for those who want a more unobstructed view of the night sky.

NOTE: the Observation Deck is only accessible via stairs, there is no elevator or other accessible entry method.

name: Artificial IntelliQuest puzzle hunt kick-off
description: What is a puzzle hunt? How do I play? Meet the organizers of this year's week-long event and get your first puzzle! Attendance not required; players may join at any time throughout the week without missing anything. Just visit our drop box in the Explorer's Lounge.

name: Mark Sonnenblick Hosts a Fun Event about Demons and the Pop Stars from Korea Who Hunt Them and Everyone Can Watch and Sing Along
description:
Mark Sonnenblick (song co-writer for KPop Demon Hunters) hosts a special event where everyone might watch something fun and sing along with it.

No recording of this event is permitted, thank you for your cooperation.

name: New Cruiser Karaoke
description: Get your sing on in the Rolling Stone Lounge with this JoCo Cruise tradition. For this intro session, everyone may (and should) attend, but only first-time attendees may perform. Come cheer on our new JoCo Cruisers!

name: Atlas Hugged - Podcast dry run
description: Tired of seeing young men fall into the rightwing pipeline? Want to help provide an active alternative? I'm interviewing a guest on a skill they've used to find success as a man, and how they did it. Brainstorming and future guest screening after. All genders welcome. Feminism 4 mascs

name: Night Yelling (at the moon)
description:
A time-honored Cruise Tradition! Head to the back of the back deck and bring your pent-up feelings.
Pro-tip - you can wander back here to scream any old time you would like!

name: Late Night Gaming Grab and Go Snacks Begins
An Evening with James Sheppard: Part 1
description: From the Rockaways to the Ballet, this nautical cabaret features singer/pianist James Sheppard and his favorite NYC stories.

name: Theme: Cosplay Day
description: Today is the day to really let your cosplay flag fly! While you're welcome to cosplay any and all days of the cruise, this is your day for pulling out all the stops. Particularly if you're cosplaying as a pipe organ.

name: Morning Qigong Class
description: Qigong is a gentle, movement-based meditation that anybody can do to stimulate your ‘qi’, or energy for the day. Join Andrea Hildebran Smith for an hour of exercises from the Flowing Zen school of qigong. We’ll learn the Eight Pieces of Brocade series and enjoy practicing them together.

name: Medieval Miscellany
description: Come learn about a random topic from the European and Mediterranean Middle Ages (500–1500 CE)! There will be a brief lecture with slides, time for questions and discussion, and suggested further reading. And possibly stickers!

name: Info Desk Hours
description:
If you need information, well heck we have information! Come here for any JoCo Cruise-related questions or issues you may have.

If you have questions or problems relating to the ship—your cabin, billing, etc—please go to the ship’s Guest Services Desk, located on the opposite side of the Atrium on Deck 1.

name: Kids Club operating hours
description: HAL offers their Kids Club youth activities program for kids and teens 3-17 years old. See the HAL Kids Club page for details. Note that operating hours for JoCo Cruise are different than those listed on that page.

name: Ukulele Melee (Almost Daily)
description: In historic fashion the uke players on the ship will be meeting and playing together each morning! All levels welcome! We are happy to teach.

name: Video Game Librarian Hours
description: World 9 Gaming staff are on hand to assist in browsing the video game library. Outside these hours a limited number of consoles will still be available.

name: Diceborn Heroes: Learn & Play
description: Diceborn Heroes is a cooperative 1-4 player fantasy dice adventure. Where players play through a scenario, defeating monsters, levelling up their hero and finally taking on a final boss. It collectively you beat the boss then you win the game! Can you save kingdom of Diavlice?

name: How it's Made: Board Games from Prototype to Product
description:
A quick overview of the board game making process:
-The economics of how a game is chosen for publishing.
-Developing a prototype into a working product (aka play testing).
-Marketing and Kickstarting.
-Manufacturing and shipping.
-How it gets into your hands.

name: Joust Mania
description: A combination of Tag, Keep-Away, and Dancing? Try to shake/jostle your opponents motion controllers, while stopping them from doing the same to you, all while keeping pace with the music. Under 12yo requires parental attendance/supervision.

name: Maker's Exchange
description: Maker’s Exchange is an opportunity for people who make things to show off what they create & trade goodies with other creators of all types! This event is when those who signed up Maker's Exchange 2025 will come together to exchange the goodies they've created.

name: Star Trek: Crossroads
description: Star Trek: TOS roleplaying using the Fate Core system. Players assume the roles of junior officers aboard the U.S.S. Ares, a Federation destroyer. Formerly titled "Horror at Sarkis V." Content warnings: Sci-fi violence, death, monsters.

name: Swing Dance Lesson and Dance Party!
description: Come swing out with Kira and Erik! Join us for a beginning swing dance / Lindy hop lesson, followed by a dance party with nerdy swing music. No partner or experience necessary.

name: Byzantine Chain Mail Rainbow Bracelet
description: Learn the classic Byzantine weave and create a colorful bracelet. This beginner friendly class will teach you foundational chain mail skills. The Byzantine pattern is a beautiful, sturdy weave that's perfect for jewelry and can be applied to countless other projects. No experience necessary and all tools and materials are supplied. Please bring glasses or magnifier if needed for close up work.

name: Genre Mashing for Fun and Penguins (Kids and Teens Edition)
description:
NOTE: this session will be structured specifically for kids and teens, and will take place on the starboard—i.e., non-bar—side of the Ocean Bar space)

Is your star command a little bland? Your magical tale kind of stale? Whether your worlds are full of magic, technology, demons, or wuxia cultivators, sometimes mixing things up can open new possibilities, introduce new perspectives—or it can just be fun.

Let's dip our metaphorical toes into the unclassifiable chaos of genre mashing—writing stories with characters and worlds that should have nothing to do with each other.

This workshop is for anyone who writes, wants to write, or just wants to try something new. Please bring pens, notebooks, crayons, laptops—whatever you use to write. There will be writing and sharing and laughter—and maybe even a little learning. And yes, our final writing prompt will invoke penguins.

name: Origami Frogs and Dinosaurs
description: Learn to fold a jumping frog and a dinosaur.

name: Daytime Quiet Zone
description:
The port side of this restaurant is a dedicated "quiet zone" for our attendees who may wish to use it. Please no gaming, meetings, loud conversations, etc. Look for signs pointing you to the correct entrance and tables.

(Note: JoCo Cruise's morning meeting with the ship's staff occurs in this space at 9:30am; it's usually finished by 10 am, but some mornings it may run a few minutes overtime. Thank you in advance for your understanding and flexibility.)

name: Puppets, Puppeteers and Puppet Fans Meetup!
description: Do you have a puppet friend along and want to introduce them to others? Are you a puppeteer and want to talk with other puppeteers? Or do you just think puppets are cool and want to hang out with some? This casual meet and greet is for you!

name: Tarot and Meditation
description: We will offer a brief introduction and discussion on both Tarot and meditation. We'll draw Tarot cards and offer simple meditative options to accompany the readings. Feel free to bring your own deck; there will be some decks provided as well.

name: Nerdy Water Exercise
description: Come to the pool and enjoy a water exercise class set to the music of our favorite musical groups. No experience necessary.

name: Sip & Stitch - social crafting
description: Bring your knitting, crocheting, embroidery, spinning, sewing or any other craft along with a coffee, tea, cocktail, or mocktail of choice as we sit, sip, and stitch on our projects. Crafters of all ages, backgrounds, and experience are welcome and encouraged.

name: Craft a Clay Gnome
description:
"oin Clay Artist Laura Parcel and learn how to sculpt your own polymer clay gnome. Class will include instruction on sculpting and constructing a basic gnome and then participants can sculpt simple accessories like clothes, hats, and more. Will your gnome be a boat captain? Or maybe a Pirate? Perhaps a Mergnome? Flower Pot Protector? It’s time for a “Choose Your Gnome Adventure”!

Gnomes will be 1.5-2 inches tall and will be cured onboard.

Info on pickup details provided in class.

Participants arriving in the final 30 min of classtime may not have sufficient time to complete a gnome; work cannot be continued after class concludes.

Participants aged 12 and up required.

name: It's a Bird! Bird Joy and Birding Basics for Bird Enthusiasts to Bird-Curious
description: Learn about birds you may see and hear on land, sea, and skies during our sailing to the Baja Peninsula; how to describe and identify birds with the Merlin Bird ID app; and the IRL birds that inspired your favorite geekdom birds, like the Millenium Falcon, Nadu, Kenku, and Zapdos

name: Learn to Play - Magic: the Gathering
description: Ever wanted to learn one of the world's most popular trading card games? Here’s your chance! No cards or experience necessary—we'll have free intro decks and a crew of expert coaches to get you started on your Magic journey.

name: JoCo Fantasy Football League Meetup
description: Are you part of the JoCo Fantasy Football League? Do you like fantasy football in general or want to learn about it? Then join us as we spend a little time putting faces to team names, reliving the season, discussing rule changes, & probably talking a little trash (all in fun).

name: Songwriting for Beginners with Tim Griffin
description: Got a song in your heart but no idea how to get it out? Tim has helped hundreds of kids and adults write their first real song, and now it’s your turn. No instrument, no problem: we’ll be writing to existing tunes. No kidding, you can do this!

name: Where’s Waldo Warm Welcome
description: All Waldos, Wendas, Woofs, Wizard Whitebeards, and Carmen Sandiegos are welcome to join in a photo and a drawing for who will be the one and only “Waldo” (giving out prizes). Be ready for people to tell you they found you only to realize you aren’t the Waldo they are looking for.

name: Painting with Diamonds
description: Learn the relaxing and meditative craft of diamond painting. In this class you'll learn the basics of diamond painting while completing a sea turtle key chain.

name: Taskmastarr Live Tasks - Year 2
description: Are you a fan of Taskmaster? Come and participate in (or watch) a number of live tasks, where ridiculous tasks will be performed, scored and/or mocked by the Taskmastarr. The winner will receive fabulous* prize. (*fabulousness not guaranteed)

name: Classic Kids' Songs Singalong
description: Come sing kids' songs with (at least one) toddler. Aimed at young kids, but older kids or adults without kids are also welcome to join, just expect to be singing simple songs like Wheels on the Bus, Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Head Shoulders Knees and Toes, etc.

name: Looking (Safely) at the Sun in H-alpha
description: Let's look at the Sun through a telescope that has a filter which rejects most of the harmful energy and only lets through Hydrogen-α light which allows us to view detail on the Sun's surface, and possibly some prominences.

name: Megan and Michael's Pirate Wedding
description: Megan and Michael are getting Marrrrrried and everyone is invited! Come join our pirate wedding for the ceremony, first dance, and an open mic for toasts! With special musical guest Mollylele!

name: Multi-day Bananagrams Tournament
description: THIRD YEAR THIRD… BEER? FEAR? TEAR?! Whatever! We’re having a multiday tournament of BANANAGRAMS for the third time in a row! Join other word scrambling enthusiasts and work your way up the brackets over 3 days of JoCo to finally reach your lifelong goal of being crowned master of all things Bananagram! If you’ve never played the game before, Bananagrams is an easy game to learn—all are welcome! Prizes will be given to winners! Prizes will also probably be given to non winners as well!

name: Lunar Skyline - Double-Suited Trick-Taking Game Demo
description: Build the first lunar metropolis in Lunar Skyline! A double-suited trick-taking game of high-stakes bidding where every trick secures resources and lucrative bonus contracts.

name: Nuclear Energy Renaissance
description: An overview of technological advancements in nuclear energy including small modular reactors (SMR) and the use of AI for safety protocols.

name: Pirate Wiz War
description: Live action board game version of the original Wiz War! The game can hold 4 to 6 players at a time. Fun to watch and play. The room will require a 20' by 20' space and incorporates live action with you as the playing piece on the board. Has been featured at KublaCon.

name: JoCo Community Archive Scrapbooking
description: We will have our scrapbooking supplies available! (This activity will take place in the general Crafting area in the forward section of the starboard side of the Lower Main Dining Room)

name: Spirit Island: Designer Office Hours / Q&A
description: Come hang out and ask the designer of Spirit Island questions! (Presumably about Spirit Island, though who knows?) Eric's also happy to sign stuff, but conversation's the main focus of this get-together.

name: High Score is open - All Ages
description: High Score, the ship's arcade, is open daily from 1 pm to 11 pm. All ages are welcome at all times. Pinball, multicades, Skeeball, and more!

name: Super Smash Bros Ultimate Tournament
description: Are you really feeling it? Well here it is! World 9 Gaming is hosting a double elimination Smash Ultimate tournament. We will use most of the standard competitive ruleset - 1v1, no items, 3 stock, neutral stages, all characters available. Show me your moves!

name: GamerWave Rave
description: The GamerWave Rave back for year 2 of synthwave on the high seas! Join us as KENKU spins the best of retro-futuristic beats, nostalgic gaming sound bites, and the 80s hits of yesteryear. Cyberpunk and 80s themed attire are encouraged!

name: Mightier than the Sword: Fountain Pen Enthusiast Meetup
description: Come for a friendly gathering of penthusiasts to show off our pretties and chat. Opportunity to try multiple fountain pens, inks, and nibs, depending on what everyone brings with them. Bring your pens and inks. Make new pen friends. Get a pentastic stamp in your Passporto. Pens!

name: Teen Meet-up
description: Meet-up for the teen cruisers on board.

name: The JoCo Six: A Secret Teams Card Game
description: Learn to play Circle of Six: A JoCo Secret Teams Card Game. You’ve always suspected that the performers on JoCo Cruise play favorites...Red Team or Gold Team? Now you get to step behind the curtain and play as one of the secretive Circle of Six.

name: Paint-and-take 3D Table Top Miniatures
description: Learn the basics of painting 3D table top miniatures and take them home with you! Materials provided.

name: Learn to Play - Two Player Games
description: Have a significant other? Or an insignificant other? Don’t have an ‘other’ but just love small group games? Come join in as we put aside time and tables for two player games. We have staff on hand to teach games you haven’t played, or to help muddle out rule questions on games you have played. Meet new people, bring old people, meet new old people! No previous gaming experience needed as we enjoy these games together.

name: Kraken Post Meetup
description: Kraken Post is a small gift exchange between cruise participants. This is an opportunity to meet other participants and put faces to the names of your team-mates.

name: Twit-arr Help Desk Hours
description: Our team will be on hand to help answer any support questions you may have.

name: Drone Delivery
description: Flying robots want to bring you all the things! Explore the challenges and technology of drone delivery to operate safely in shared airspace. Janessa was part of the flight ops team for the first US commercial drone delivery company approved by the FAA (Part 135).

name: Kittens in Space - Casual Card-Shedding Game Demo!
description: Kittens in Space is a light, fast & furry-ous card game for up to 6 players! Rescue and rehome cosmic cats in a low-gravity shelter as you race to shed your hand first. Chaotic, casual, and cat-astrophically cute!

name: Turkish Fold Maps
description:
Learn to fold and glue a map into a cover, then personalize it with drawing, coloring, and stamping. Map making predates written history and has been independently invented by cultures worldwide. In this class, you'll creating your own personalized keepsake.

What You'll Get:
- Two pre-printed maps (illustrated cruise route map & coastline)
- Two Covers
- 40-page zine with instructions for making your own illustrated maps
- Bone Folder
- Pen and Pencil

The Craft Room has additional coloring supplies when classes are not in session. You may also decorate using Passporto stamps hidden around the ship.

name: Magic: the Gathering Meet and Greet
description: An informal time for MTG players to gather, chat and set up their own play times and pods throughout the week. No official play session or product, just a time for socializing.

name: Office Half Hour With Community Care Officer Thera
description: Spend some time with Community Care Officer Thera, she'll be so happy to see you! Bring your questions, concerns, and high-fives!

name: Things They Don’t Tell You About Being an Astronaut
description:
Microbiologist and retired NASA astronaut Kate Rubins discusses the surprises—both good and bad—of traveling to and living in space.

Recording/reposting of this event will not be permitted, thank you for your cooperation.

name: Cheese lovers meet up
description:
Calling all the lovers of cheese. Bring your favorite cheese or local specialty cheese, or favorite cheese enhancer to share. Hang out with us while we savor many varieties of deliciousness.

This event will take place on the starboard side of the Ocean Bar (the one with all the tables and chairs, not the side with the bar and stage).

name: Creating an Oracle Deck with Collectible Card Games
description: We'll look into how to create a unique, personalized oracle deck using cards from collectible card games (MTG, Pokemon, Yu-Gi-Oh, etc.). Feel free to bring your own set of favorite cards or even a playable deck.

name: Ten Tips for Fascinating Photos
description: Using the ship as a subject, learn 10 tips to compose interesting, fun photos. All types of cameras welcome - I exclusively use my iPhone - and no apps required. We will meet in an open area, take photos indoors, then move outdoors if weather permits.

name: BIPOC Meet-Up
description: A chance to meet up with other BIPOC folks onboard!

name: Care for your Fascia! Feet & Hands Edition
description: You will gently massage your hands and feet, utilizing a rubber ball, guided by MELT Method self-treatment techniques that restore hydration to the fascia and enhance nervous system’s connections. You will be able to feel a difference immediately. Starts promptly, no latecomers.

name: Anti-Gravity Derby
description:
This year we’re challenging all engineers, artists, safety-conscious daredevils, and anyone else who likes fun to construct a paper aircraft that will stay afloat as long as possible. Because the last one to hit the Atrium floor WINS! Kudos and prizes* will also be awarded for Artistic Merit, and/or Ingenuity. Plus other fun surprises (tbd).

To participate, meet Coach Cruise (Storm) and Cruise Mom (Thera) in the Ocean Bar (Deck 3, Midship) with your aircraft ready to waft. Those wishing to witness the spectacle are encouraged to go to the Deck 2 Atrium area, or Deck 1 just outside of the central Atrium.

Complete rules and info can be found here, as well as attached to this event listing in Sched.

*Kudos and Prizes is the name of Storm and Thera’s stage magic act

name: Clear dining room for dinner service setup
description: The Main Dining Room staff need time to reset the tables for dinner service; we ask that you please wrap up your games and clear the Main Dining Room at 3 pm each day (except today, at 3:30, because dinner is 30 minutes later than usual. Lucky you!) Thanks! Plenty more tables all over the ship for gaming!

name: Pre-teen/teen meet and greet (age 11-15)
description:
A space to let older kids meet and mingle. Hang out, play a game or two and make some friends.

Parents are welcome but not required. Adults will be present but if you are not comfortable with your child being independent and allowed to come and go, please stay.

name: Speed Meeting
description:
Are you anxious about being on a big boat with a bunch of strangers? What if they WEREN'T strangers - but the friends in this friendSHIP! FRIENDSHIP ASSEMBLE!

Speed Meeting is a facilitated and casually structured event that allows you to cross that barrier and meet new people!

This is a drop-in, drop-out event. Come whenever you can, leave when you need to!

name: Jim Boggia Tunes Your Ukulele
description: Jim Boggia is very well known for several things: his strong ukulele skills, and his fine ear. So much so that, on JoCo Cruise at least, small degrees of sharpness and flatness are measured in "Boggias." This morning, Jim Boggia will sit on the Sea View Pool deck and turn his finely-honed tuning ability upon your ukulele—or any other stringed instrument* you bring him—until it is tuned to a degree of perfection usually reserved for the finest Stradavariuses.

name: Make a JoCo Treasure Chest Geocache
description: Come help decorate and add fun items in treasure chest geocaches, to be placed when we're in port. Make some magic for future people to discover and delight in.

name: People with Disabilities Meet-Up
description: Space for attendees with any disability to connect!

name: Solo Traveler Meet-Up
description: We invite all you intrepid solo travelers to come and say hello to each other!

name: Billboard Onboard Happy Hour
description: Happy hour! Your second drink is only $2!

name: Kids Club operating hours
description: HAL offers their Kids Club youth activities program for kids and teens 3-17 years old. See the HAL Kids Club page for details. Note that operating hours for JoCo Cruise are different than those listed on that page.

name: Ocean Bar Happy Hour
description: Happy hour! Your second drink is only $2!

name: Meaningful, and Maybe Pretty: A Cappella Concert
description: Drew & friends perform songs like they did in college.

name: Costuming & Cosplay Cocktail Mixer
description: Do you have a favorite costume that you'd like to share on Joco Cruise 2026? Come meet fellow Cosplayers & Costumers on for a Happy Hour mixer. You'll have a chance to say "Hi" to friends and meet some new ones. There will also be an opportunity for photos.

name: Creating an Immersive Home Bar or Space
description: Create your own immersive environment: a tiki bar, Disney-inspired room, game room, etc. Based on Stephen's own home speakeasy and tiki presentations, he covers “rules,” tips and tricks for a top-notch immersive space -- even for renters and any budget! [Book & mug raffle]

name: Main Concert (Gold Team) - Julia Shiplett, Ron Funches
description: The performers request that no recordings be made of this performance. Thank you.

name: Main Concert (Red Team) - Julia Shiplett, Ron Funches
description: The performers request that no recordings be made of this performance. Thank you.

name: Nighttime Quiet Zone
description: The starboard side of the Lido Marketplace will be designated the "quiet side" after 9 pm. Other than at the designated 24/7 gaming tables in the aft section, no gaming, no meetings, no loud noises, please. Take yer excessive noise over to the port side, please—or to the back deck, where the late-night pizza is!

description: Make a paper charm and attempt to draw your name in Egyptian hieroglyphs on it, or a different word if you prefer. Reference a collection of English sounds and phonemes in hieroglyphs, examples, or a dictionary. Some info on the language and a translation activity also provided!

name: A Crash Course in Planetary Defense
description: The Earth is hit by material all the time, and in this case bigger is definitely not better. Hear a planetary scientist involved with the DART mission discuss what we know about defending our planet from asteroids, what we don't know, and what we're doing about it.

name: Non-Binary Meetup
description: Join in on a casual meetup where any and all non-binary folx are invited to gather and gab. Look for the big non-binary flag, host will bring stickers!

name: Experimental Theater Mixtape
description: Join theater maker and amateur theater historian Blake Bolan for a guided tour through a selection of 19th, 20th and 21st century Western experimental performance legends and underground cult heroes, and explore why non-traditional works are still so vital today.

name: Campfire Music Jam Sing-a-long (We're not unreasonable - no one's gonna light a fire)
description: Remember sitting around a campfire with your friends and singing songs? Wanna try it on a boat? Come jam & sing folk, 70s & nerdy songs with others. No singing talent required! Bring your instruments & voices (skits?). Songbooks and guitar (& a faux fire!) to be provded.

name: The Python Bee
description: The Python Bee is a competition for two-person teams of coders, conducted in front of a live audience. Team partners write simple Python programs, one symbol at a time (alternating between the partners), all without seeing the screen! Awesome prizes and hilarity are guaranteed!

name: The Talking Cat Journey - with Mary Robinette Kowal
description: What if your cat could tell you where it hurts — or thank you for helping? Science fiction author Mary Robinette Kowal shares her four-year journey with Elsie, a 7-year-old calico with a 130-word vocabulary, who uses Augmentative Interspecies Communication (AIC) to express grief, coin phrases like "laser bird," and even self-report an undiagnosed ACL injury. Learn the science behind button communication and how to start this life-changing conversation with your own pet.

name: Origami Turtle Mobile
description: Learn to make an oragami turtle, and then string several up to create a mobile.

name: Change Ringing on Handbells
description: An introduction to the pattern-based style of bellringing called change ringing. You will learn patterns and start making music on handbells right away. Come give this real-time cooperative sport a try!

name: Talent Show and Tell!!

"This year on Wednesday, the 25th, we'll be throwing our annual Pride party, in March, at the Sea View Pool. The theme for this year is "Pride in Space." In terms of the moodboard it is, well, space—and also The Pride of Chanur because of puns and because the cover is fabulous. 

"It turns out that people wear party clothes in space when they're in atmosphere—e.g. when attending a soiree aboard the General Systems Vehicle, the Empiricist—so I wouldn't stress too much about having the perfect thing to wear. But, I'll also note that in space-space people wear space stuff or are maybe aliens.

"And, finally, I'll note: LIONESSES (THE HANI) COMMAND STARSHIPS IN AN UNEASY INTERSPECIES INTERSTELLAR COMPACT AND THINGS DO NOT GET SIMPLER WHEN A HUMAN, AN OUTSIDER, SEEKS REFUGE ABOARD HANI CAPTAIN PYANFAR CHANUR'S VESSEL."

name: My Immortal: A Dramatic Reading
description: Join us as we celebrate 20 YEARS of what is regarded as the worst fanfiction ever published online. Whether you've only heard rumors of this infamous work or have joined us for previous readings, all are welcome as we explore the legend of Ebony Dark'ness Dementia Raven Way.

name: Late Night Gaming Grab and Go Snacks Begins
The Book of Sauron: Geek Humor and LOTR Extra Scenes
description: Standup and improvised comedy about a variety of geeky topics. Includes previously unseen extra scenes from the LOTR movies and the yet to be produced "Book of Sauron" musical.

name: Kraken Me Up Comedy Open Mic
description: Add some extra funny to your day with stand up comedy performances from fellow JoCo cruise friends. Whether you're already a comic, or just always wanted to give stand up a shot, get together your best 3-5 minutes of (JoCo-friendly) material and show up!

name: Theme: Formal Night
description: Formal wear is encouraged, but not required, at dinner. "Formal wear" is defined VERY flexibly. Tuxedo and cocktail dress? Fine. Sport coat and slacks? Sure. Starfleet uniform? Awesome. Full Scottish regalia? Bonnie. You get the idea. Fancy headwear (tiaras, hats, etc.—a sort of JCC tradition for many) welcomed, but not required.

name: Morning Qigong Class
description: Qigong is a gentle, movement-based meditation that anybody can do to stimulate your ‘qi’, or energy for the day. Join Andrea Hildebran Smith for an hour of exercises from the Flowing Zen school of qigong. We’ll learn the Eight Pieces of Brocade series and enjoy practicing them together.

name: Info Desk Hours
description:
If you need information, well heck we have information! Come here for any JoCo Cruise-related questions or issues you may have.

If you have questions or problems relating to the ship—your cabin, billing, etc—please go to the ship’s Guest Services Desk, located on the opposite side of the Atrium on Deck 1.

name: Kids Club operating hours
description: HAL offers their Kids Club youth activities program for kids and teens 3-17 years old. See the HAL Kids Club page for details. Note that operating hours for JoCo Cruise are different than those listed on that page.

name: Earl Grey Yoga
description: Join me on the mat for a beginner's level yoga class. I will lead a gentle yoga practice while sharing the wisdom of Jean-Luc Picard. No experience necessary. Feel free to join just to listen, even if you don't want to practice with us. Please, bring a mat or towel.

name: Ukulele Melee (Almost Daily)
description: In historic fashion the uke players on the ship will be meeting and playing together each morning! All levels welcome! We are happy to teach.

name: Video Game Librarian Hours
description: World 9 Gaming staff are on hand to assist in browsing the video game library. Outside these hours a limited number of consoles will still be available.

name: Lido Deck "Last Chance" Merch Sale
description: A satellite store will be set up in the Lido Pool Area for all your JoCo Cruise merch needs.

name: Management Q&A
description: The JoCo Cruise Management sit on a stage and answer your questions about JoCo Cruise. Pretty straightforaward, actually.

name: Diceborn Heroes: Learn & Play
description: Diceborn Heroes is a cooperative 1-4 player fantasy dice adventure. Where players play through a scenario, defeating monsters, levelling up their hero and finally taking on a final boss. It collectively you beat the boss then you win the game! Can you save kingdom of Diavlice?

name: Eurovision: A Panel Discussion and Live Request Show
description: For 70 years, Eurovision has been enthralling and puzzling audiences in equal measure. Join a coterie of Eurovision superfans in your finest sequins (if desired) to discuss the highs, lows, and camp amazingness of it all. A panel presentation on the history of the contest and how it has changed over time. Followed by freeform Q&A and live Eurovision requests/morning dance party!

name: Q&A with Connie Vogelmann, designer of Apiary and Wyrmspan
description: Join us for a Q&A with Connie Vogelmann, designer of Apiary & Wyrmspan. Connie loves exploring different systems in board games, fusing simple rulesets with rich tactical decisions. Hosted by Elli Amir, designer of Worldbreakers: Advent of the Khanate.

name: Star Trek: Hourglass
description: Star Trek: TOS roleplaying using the Fate Core system. Players assume the roles of junior officers aboard the U.S.S. Eisenhower, a Federation destroyer. Content warnings: Sci-fi violence, death, natural disasters.

name: Make your own Passporto Stamp
description: We will show you how to create art work that can be converted into an inked rubber stamp. Inks and stamp holders will be provided to convert your art into an actual passporto stamp. Draw freehand or bring some art to trace onto translucent paper used by the machine. We will have a few impromptu sessions at other times for people unable to attend scheduled session.

name: Daytime Quiet Zone
description:
The port side of this restaurant is a dedicated "quiet zone" for our attendees who may wish to use it. Please no gaming, meetings, loud conversations, etc. Look for signs pointing you to the correct entrance and tables.

(Note: JoCo Cruise's morning meeting with the ship's staff occurs in this space at 9:30am; it's usually finished by 10 am, but some mornings it may run a few minutes overtime. Thank you in advance for your understanding and flexibility.)

name: AcroYoga Jam and Introductory Class
description: We're back for the 6th year! This will be a intro to Acroyoga followed by some open practice time. Acroyoga is a the skill of balancing people on other people and moving through fun and interesting shapes. What could go wrong balancing on top of a person on a swaying boat

name: Sensory-Friendly/Kids Friendly Dance Party
description: Not everyone who loves to dance loves the music at top volume. Join this all-ages dance party where we keep the energy up and the music low. We'll have some geeky, fun kids music mixed with family-friendly dance classics.

name: Magic: the Gathering Draft
description: Join us for a free Magic: the Gathering draft, where you'll open booster packs and select cards to build a brand new deck. Thanks to some generous volunteers, you even get to keep the cards!

name: Nerdy Water Exercise
description: Come to the pool and enjoy a water exercise class set to the music of our favorite musical groups. No experience necessary.

name: Secret Movie Swap!
description: Physical media! Remember that? Bring a gift-wrapped copy of your favorite movie on physical media (blu-ray or 4K preferred) and we’ll have ourselves a good old fashioned movie swap!

name: Paint-and-take 3D Table Top Miniatures
description: Learn the basics of painting 3D table top miniatures and take them home with you! Materials provided.

name: (Not) Everybody’s a Critic
description: Criticism is about giving perspective on art...but criticism is itself an art, and the people who do it well are creating work of value. In this panel we’ll look at what criticism is, its role as service journalism as well as critical evaluation, who have been groundbreaking critics...and what it’s like when the critic hops over to the other side of the critical fence.

name: Geek Out On Tomatoes & Grow Your Own!
description: Heirloom, hybrid, indeterminate, determinate, dwarf, micro-dwarf - what does it all mean? Have it Mike-splained™ in a fun crash course and at the end choose a few seeds from Mike's 150 varieties to take home to grow your own - even 8" varieties that can be grown on a counter!

name: How to Cheat at Piano
description: Cheat codes for piano! Learn the cheat codes that gamify learning piano. Read the cheat sheet in advance at basilwhite.com/cheatcodes.txt and choose your cheats you want to learn! Bring an instrument if you have one, otherwise, bring your youness!

name: Yarn Swap
description: Calling all crafters! We’re hosting another yarn and fiber arts swap! Bring the yarn, notions, patterns, needles, WIPs you won’t finish, etc. to the yarn swap! Meet other fiber artists and swap!

name: Indian Specialty Lunch
description:
The Nieuw Amsterdam's culinary staff are preparing this specialty meal of Indian cuisine as a one-time-only event for our passengers. Seating is limited, so sign up early if you are interested.

This event is run by the ship's staff and costs a $17.50 surcharge (which includes an 18% service charges) that will be charged to your onboard account. You can sign up in the Main Dining Room, or by calling 88 from any phone.

name: Silent Auction Closes
description: This is your final chance to bid on the items in the Silent Auction; proceeds benefit Equality Florida as well as the Nieuw Amsterdam's Crew Activity Fund.

name: SemiFi Stories for the Vibrant Mind ( Tottom&Bop music)
description:
transfem, neurospicy musician Rose Gilraen is thrilled to share a live performance of Fry Love You, an immersive, spoken word poem about a robot who fell in love with a potato - & some queer music as Tottom&Bop!
(CN: contains references to abuse, death, loss; ends with optimism)

name: LGBTQ Party Game Social
description: Mingle and play event with party games poolside designed for and run by members of the LGBTQ community.

name: Pop-Up Choir Rehearsal: Golden (from KPop Demon Hunters)
description:
Join us for a friendly and fun session where we'll build a choir: one ship, one song, one day (no auditions). If you can hum in the shower, you're qualified!

During this session we'll play some fun singing games and warmups, practice the song in sections and as a full group, and discuss the meaning and emotion behind the music. Immediately afterward, we'll make our way to the Atrium to perform our work for the assembled masses and casually record it to share with each other and the world.

For those who like to prepare in advance, you can find the choral arrangement and learning materials linked to this event, or in this Google drive. It can be very helpful to listen through a few times, but it's NOT required. Feel free to just show up, we'll have printed copies available.

name: Multi-day Bananagrams Tournament - Round Two
description: THIRD YEAR THIRD… BEER? FEAR? TEAR?! Whatever! We’re having a multiday tournament of BANANAGRAMS for the third time in a row! Join other word scrambling enthusiasts and work your way up the brackets over 3 days of JoCo to finally reach your lifelong goal of being crowned master of all things Bananagram! If you’ve never played the game before, Bananagrams is an easy game to learn—all are welcome! Prizes will be given to winners! Prizes will also probably be given to non winners as well!

name: Transferable Skills
description: Most writers “come up” or become best known for one sort of writing: journalism, comics writing, screenwriting, etc. Then many of them try their hand and a different discipline of writing altogether. In this panel, we look at what artistic and commercial skills learned in one field turn out to have application in another, and which of these transferable skills might have been surprising to our panelists.

name: Classic Kids' Songs Singalong
description: Come sing kids' songs with (at least one) toddler. Aimed at young kids, but older kids or adults without kids are also welcome to join, just expect to be singing simple songs like Wheels on the Bus, Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Head Shoulders Knees and Toes, etc.

name: Lunar Skyline - Double-Suited Trick-Taking Game Demo
description: Build the first lunar metropolis in Lunar Skyline! A double-suited trick-taking game of high-stakes bidding where every trick secures resources and lucrative bonus contracts.

name: JoCo Community Archive Scrapbooking
description: We will have our scrapbooking supplies available! (This activity will take place in the general Crafting area in the forward section of the starboard side of the Lower Main Dining Room)

name: Almost Magic! (magic show)
description:
Award winning magician Seren Goldsmith returns for the third time with her unique blend of comedy and magic! Impossible feats, or an example of Clarke's 3rd law? Come judge for yourself!
Side effects may include laughter, confusion, Rubik's cube mastery, and mild drooling.

name: High Score is open - All Ages
description: High Score, the ship's arcade, is open daily from 1 pm to 11 pm. All ages are welcome at all times. Pinball, multicades, Skeeball, and more!

name: Mashups Trivia
description: Come play 4-6 rounds of some fun wordplay trivia, the answers will be either punny mashups or before-and-after style.

name: Merfolk Parade Float
description: Every parade needs a float, and that is something that merfolk do exceedingly well! Join us in the pool during the FPP and cheer for our leg-bearing friends! Tails may be available to try.

name: Zymurgy — The arts of fermentation
description: Social gathering of people interested in fermentables of all kinds.

name: Fancy Pants Parade
description: An annual tradition. Bring your fanciest pants and vie for the trophy. Who will be the best in terms of pants?

name: Magic: the Gathering - Commander Meetup
description: Bring your commander decks to play with other MTG players who love the format. no tournament, no pressure, just good old fashioned magic. You must bring your own product to participate, loaner decks may be available but not guaranteed.

name: Kittens in Space - Casual Card-Shedding Game Demo!
description: Kittens in Space is a light, fast & furry-ous card game for up to 6 players! Rescue and rehome cosmic cats in a low-gravity shelter as you race to shed your hand first. Chaotic, casual, and cat-astrophically cute!

name: Torilena queer trans singer/songwriter
description:
Torilena (she/they) is a queer trans femme singer/songwriter based in San Francisco / on Ohlone land.
See torilena.com
Their music blends rock, pop, soul, reggae, and afrobeat into emotionally resonant anthems.
“Torilena’s stories are whole novels squeezed into a 3 minute song”

name: Nisa Longga: The Spicy Link-Up
description:
Tiny package, hella flavor. Genre-hopping bangers, Tita's favorite line-dances, slaps that knock hard, and pool deck chaos hotter than your longganisa breakfast.

(You may also recognize Nisa as Ruby Ibarra's kick-ass drummer.)

name: Ask the Writers Literally Anything
description: Exactly what the title promises: we writers sit up there on stage and then you ask us anything: About writing, about publishing, about creativity, about our pets, about our favorite TV shows, so on and so forth. It’s your chance to get into the mind of a writer! Protective gear optional!

name: Mario Kart 64 Tournament
description: It's a tradition now, welcome back to the annual MK64 tournament hosted by World 9 Gaming! Rules are pods of 4 players will play 4 races in 150cc, each picking 1 track. Scoring is based on Grand Prix (9/6/3/1). Top 2 advance each round. Prizes will be awarded to top 3!

name: Ready Room (Game Room) Unavailable Until 3:00 pm
JoCoCrips and Spoonies (JoCoNauts with Disabilities and/or Chronic Illnesses)
description: A little time and space for JoCoNauts with disabilities and chronic illnesses to meet up, chat, and discuss. Self-identification is fine; we won't check your credentials at the door.

name: Pockets, darts and gussets
description: Altering clothing for fit and function. Make off the rack clothes into costumes, make clothes fit you and POCKETS!

name: Introduction to Fountain Pens
description: Possibly more than you ever wanted to know about fountain pens and ink. A nerdy introduction to how pens work and all the ink options, and a chance to play around with several types of pen.

name: Pop-up Choir - Performance: "Golden" (from KPop Demon Hunters)
Tim Griffin: songs of STEAM!
description: Tim Griffin is a retired STEM teacher and an award-winning writer/performer of educational songs about science, math, and other great stuff. Think “Schoolhouse Rock” and you’ve got the idea. Laugh and learn to songs about biochemistry, aerospace, and that stain on the lab floor.

name: Ten Tips for Fascinating Photos
description: Using the ship as a subject, learn 10 tips to compose interesting, fun photos. All types of cameras welcome - I exclusively use my iPhone - and no apps required. We will meet in an open area, take photos indoors, then move outdoors if weather permits.

name: Clear dining room for dinner service setup
description: The Main Dining Room staff need time to reset the tables for dinner service; we ask that you please wrap up your games and clear the Main Dining Room at 3 pm each day. Thanks! Plenty more tables all over the ship for gaming!

name: Ready Room (Game Room) Unavailable Until 4:45 pm
Leo Silverman Ukulele Concert
description: Leo Silverman is the teenage King of Yacht Rock. This will be his fourth year playing a concert on JoCo. Come hear his impressive singing and playing of hits from the 70's and 80's as well as his first original song! There might even be a surprise celebrity guest!

name: Pickleball 101: First Contact
description: Why is everyone obsessed with this oddly named sport? Come find out. We’ll learn the basics of pickleball, do some low-pressure practice, and embrace the joy of small paddles, funny bounces, and unexpectedly excellent fun. Beginners very welcome.

name: Slideshow Soiree
description: Have a special interest(of course you do)? Have a Hot Take? Ideas on how to placate a cryptid and make them your bestie? This is your chance to share! Come prepared with a 5-10min presentation on a PG-13 or lower topic, and infodump on us! (no business presentations or sales)

name: Office Hours with Cheapass Games
description: Lo and behold, Cheapass Games is somehow back in the hands of its creators! Join James Ernest and Carol Monahan for informal office hours, to talk about where they are, and where they are going. We will take questions & be entertaining, and perhaps play one of James' games.

name: Pagan/Witchy meet up
description: Calling all Pagans, Heathens, Witches, and other polytheistic people! Let's meet up, talk religion, do some magic(k), have a tasty beverage/potion!

name: Papercraft Make and Take!
description: Learn how to make 3d models with paper! Materials provided, make something fun and take it with you!

name: Style Skills Exchange
description: Baffled by bowties? Bewildered by braids? Mystified by makeup? Join the Style Skills Exchange! All genders welcome to teach, learn, and celebrate the fun of looking and feeling your best.

name: Billboard Onboard Happy Hour
description: Happy hour! Drinks are 50% off!

name: Kids Club operating hours
description: HAL offers their Kids Club youth activities program for kids and teens 3-17 years old. See the HAL Kids Club page for details. Note that operating hours for JoCo Cruise are different than those listed on that page.

name: Ocean Bar Happy Hour
description: Happy hour! Drinks are 50% off!

name: Office Half Hour With Community Care Officer Thera
description: Spend some time with Community Care Officer Thera, she'll be so happy to see you! Bring your questions, concerns, and high-fives!

name: Fancy Headwear and Moustache Formal
description: Come up to the Lido Pool area in your Fancy Clothes (or whatever you feel like wearing) for the fanciest happy hour there ever was! Admire others' finery and be admired in turn. Fancy headwear and/or moustaches encouraged, but not required. Moustaches available as needed.

name: Being Trans in 2026 America
description:
Suggestions, Tips, Tricks, Referrals, U.S. state comparisons, foreign country options, then Q&A

A heartfelt (& heart-full ♥️) welcome to all of our trans and gender-diverse cruisers!

I was curious if any of us might like to have an informal get together and talk about the current challenges in each of our states, tips you may have picked up on how best to stay safe when in "hostile territory", or if there's anything one or more of us needs desperately that another one of us might be able to assist with.

Let's chat!

name: Cruise Archive Deadline
description: Scrapbook pages must be turned in to the Info Desk by noon on Thursday, day 6

name: Main Concert (Gold Team) - "Worst First Chapter"; Improv Group
Main Concert (Red Team) - "Worst First Chapter"; Improv Group
Nighttime Quiet Zone
description: The starboard side of the Lido Marketplace will be designated the "quiet side" after 9 pm. Other than at the designated 24/7 gaming tables in the aft section, no gaming, no meetings, no loud noises, please. Take yer excessive noise over to the port side, please—or to the back deck, where the late-night pizza is!

name: Good Morning, JoCo
description:
If there were a liiitle tiiiny bayyyybeee Jonathan Coulton who was just sleeping sooo soundly, "Good Morning, JoCo" is what you would say to wake him up, so he could cheerfully start his day trying to escape from the terrarium where you keep him next to a scale model of the Gowanus Canal.

"Good Morning, JoCo" is ALSO a daily live-to-tape late-night-format morning show filmed in the Rolling Stone Lounge. The late night format comes from filming it right after the main concert each evening, which is later at night.

So listen here, join your hosts River Butcher and Daphne Always and their surprise guests—and their planned guests like StormCenter5 Host Storm DiCostanzo.

Come to our live taping for blue jokes, stupid props, jargon related to television production that may or may or not be necessary, reshoots, people wearing gnome hats, and adult themes. We aren't checking ids, but don't yell at us if someone drops a swear that's related to a complex topic you're not ready to explain to an audience member in your charge.

And catch the finished show the next morning! Presented in glorious 1080p at a blistering 3,000 kbps, Good Morning JoCo is a PG-ish delight for the whole family when viewed in your stateroom.

name: An Evening with James Sheppard: Part 2
description: From the Rockaways to the Ballet, this nautical cabaret features singer/pianist James Sheppard and his favorite NYC stories.

name: WornWanderers - Wearable TCG - Learn to play/Deckbuilding/Get the pins!
description:
Come get your demo starter set and play on the boat!

For this event I will be teaching the game, doing deck building, and showing team designs. People who attend are welcome to

name: Night Yelling (at the moon)
description:
A time-honored Cruise Tradition! Head to the back of the back deck and bring your pent-up feelings.
Pro-tip - you can wander back here to scream any old time you would like!

name: Bar Trek II: The Wrath of Cointreau
description:
Lay in a course for the Goodtime System, Warp Factor FUN! (Ugh, we already apologize for all this.)

Four drinks, four bars (Crow's Nest Bar, Lido Pool Bar, Ocean Bar and Billboard Onboard), lots of people making friends. Hop, hop, hop, hop! Sign up via any bartender or bar server, or at the ship's Guest Services Desk. (This event is run by the ship's staff and costs a $29 surcharge plus 18% service charges, which will be charged to your onboard account)

name: Lights off for stargazing
description:
We have the ship turn off the lights overhead and clear away the deck chairs up here each night from 10 pm to 12 am, for those who want a more unobstructed view of the night sky.

NOTE: the Observation Deck is only accessible via stairs, there is no elevator or other accessible entry method.

name: Celebrity Karaoke
description: Come hang out and belt at the top of your lungs (as appropriate) with Principal Sabourin and a bunch of our performers in a big fun karaoke sing-along extravaganza. (Performers TBA)

name: Abortion! Everything you've always wanted to know but were too afraid to ask
description: There's so much rhetoric about abortion these days but what does it all mean? Come learn about the history and context of abortion, the different types of abortions, and why it is truly essential healthcare for all in a trans-inclusive, reproductive justice-centered space.

name: John Scalzi's Nerd Prom Dance Party
description: A JoCo Cruise tradition, DJ Scalzi plays into the night as you all promise you'll stay friends forever even after you've headed off to different colleges and cities. Enchantment UPON the sea!

name: Dance Hell: The Return
description: Last year we pushed the limits of dance music. This year we go beyond them. Dance Hell returns to JoCo with an all new set of weird tunes that'll get you on your feet and out of your comfort zone. You can even claim a prize from the Dance Devil himself—if you survive the night!

name: Grand Trivia Night
description: A fun and friendly trivia night with clever original questions, accessible to all levels of participants and hosted by Keith and Allen, two experienced trivia hosts from NYC and Philly. We'll laugh, we'll cry, we'll add up the points, and we'll award some cool prizes!

name: Polyamory Meetup
description: Welcome all polyam and ethically non-monogamous JoCoNauts to your annual meetup(s)! Come chat with other ethically non-monogamous folks about google calendar, compersion, and whatever strikes your fancy. Of course we're having 2 again this year, can't have just 1 of anything!

name: Late Night Gaming Grab and Go Snacks Begins
Theme: Jammies Day
description: Everyone's running out of clean clothes anyway, so today is one big day-long celebration of the fact that nobody can make us put on "real" clothes if we don't want to!

name: Info Desk Hours
description:
If you need information, well heck we have information! Come here for any JoCo Cruise-related questions or issues you may have.

If you have questions or problems relating to the ship—your cabin, billing, etc—please go to the ship’s Guest Services Desk, located on the opposite side of the Atrium on Deck 1.

name: Kids Club operating hours
description: HAL offers their Kids Club youth activities program for kids and teens 3-17 years old. See the HAL Kids Club page for details. Note that operating hours for JoCo Cruise are different than those listed on that page.

name: Ukulele Melee (Almost Daily)
description: In historic fashion the uke players on the ship will be meeting and playing together each morning! All levels welcome! We are happy to teach.

name: Onboard Booking Form Deadline
description: Onboard Booking forms must be turned in to the Info Desk by 10 am on Saturday, day 7

name: "Not the Face!" A Voice Acting Panel
description: Janet Varney leads a discussion with several of our very talented voice-acting guests.

name: AI and You: The Automated Age
description: Generative AI. LLMs. Chatbots. The last few years have seen these cause massive disruption in our lives. What is AI good at? What is it NOT good at? How does it work? What happens when things go sideways? I will try to inform when and how to use AI responsibly and when not to.

name: Papercraft Make and Take!
description: Learn how to make 3d models with paper! Materials provided, make something fun and take it with you!

name: Staying Safe in the Online World
description: Worried about scams? Afraid you will get hooked by a Phish? Let me help you understand how to stay safe in the turbulent waters of the internet.

name: Mosaic Crochet
description:
Already know how to crochet and want to learn a new technique? In this class you will learn how to overlay mosaic crochet in a simple, quick and fun project- a simplified JoCo icon. All you need to know is hot to do a chain, single and double crochet and how to work front and back loops. We will teach you the rest!

You can bring a small amount of your favorite yarn in 2 contrasting colors and hook to match yarn or yarn and hook will be provided. We will be using 2 20g balls of size 4 weight and a 5mm or 5.5mm hook.

name: Daytime Quiet Zone
description:
The port side of this restaurant is a dedicated "quiet zone" for our attendees who may wish to use it. Please no gaming, meetings, loud conversations, etc. Look for signs pointing you to the correct entrance and tables.

(Note: JoCo Cruise's morning meeting with the ship's staff occurs in this space at 9:30am; it's usually finished by 10 am, but some mornings it may run a few minutes overtime. Thank you in advance for your understanding and flexibility.)

name: Half Moon/Stuyvesant Room Unavailable All Day
Speaking in Tongues - Language Enthusiast Meetup with Storm
description:
A no-pressure, no-judgment hangout for people learning different languages or considering learning other languages. All levels of proficiency welcome! Willkommen, bienvenue, bienvenidos, welkom—welcome!

If you're interested in attending this event, please fill out this form to help us better prepare the event towards everyone's needs.

name: A Discussion About ADHD
description: Literally, a discussion about ADHD, what it is, symptoms, how it manifests, treatments, therapy, drugs, living with it, personal experiences, resources.

name: Mexican Brunch
description: This is not a "specialty lunch" and doesn't cost anything; rather, the menu for brunch in the dining room on this day includes various Mexican dishes.

name: Guitar Hero Tournament
description: Who wants to be a rockstar? Join us on the virtual stage for a head to head contest of finger speed! Games will be played on the Playstation 2 using every version of Guitar Hero and Rock Band with over 800 songs to choose! Depending on turnout early matches may be single elimination, finals best of 3. Players may choose any difficulty, winner is determined by high score (note higher difficulties have a higher score cap).

name: Speed Puzzling
description: Join us for JoCo's first Speed Puzzling event! The goal is to assemble your puzzle as quickly as possible. Folks will compete as teams of 4 and each team will get to keep their puzzle. Sign up ahead of time in the game library.

name: Getting Fancy with Filet Crochet
description:
Learn the basics of filet crochet, as well as some tips and tricks that were learned the hard way! We will deconstruct the stitches used to create a grid, learn how to read a chart, and start our own small filet crochet project.

Supplies will be provided.

name: What I Would Have Liked to Know When I Was Starting Out
description: When I was starting my career 45 years ago, I would have benefitted strongly from having someone say "Here are things you should know that will save you time, money, and pain if you learn them now.” This is the distilled wisdom of the Ancients, hand-distilled by me.

name: Friday Afternoon Magic
description: Love MTG, wanted to play all cruise, but there just wasn't the right event for it? This is it! A veritable smorgasbord of all the Magic: The Gathering we could offer! Wanna play commander? Sure! Draft? Maybe! Cube! yeah! Make an exquisite 3-piece suit out of glued-together commons? Weird, but ok! Come one, come all to get together with like-minded MTG gamers and play to your heart's content.

name: How to Train Your (insert pet here)
description: Dog? Cat? Bearded dragon? Chupacabra? You name it, I'll train it. Learn from a zookeeper turned pet-trainer the basics of positive reinforcement training for behavior change for your fur/feather/scale children.

name: Deepfakes, Manufactured Reality, and How to Protect Yourself and Democracy
description: AI-generated audio, video, and images are blurring the line between truth and fiction in ways that are already reshaping politics, culture, and public trust. Deepfakes are not just viral curiosities. They are tools that can be used to manipulate elections, damage reputations, inflame violence, and undermine confidence in democratic institutions. Marginalized groups are often targeted first, making this both a technology issue and a civil rights issue.

name: 3rd Annual JoCo Book Club Blind Book Exchange
description: Our 3rd annual gathering of JoCo BookClub bibliophiles! Bring a WRAPPED book to share for an exchange game and you’ll get to take home a hopefully new-to-you book! Everyone is welcome to socialize, though if you don’t bring a book you will not be able to participate in the game!

name: Multi-day Bananagrams Tournament - Round Three
description: THIRD YEAR THIRD… BEER? FEAR? TEAR?! Whatever! We’re having a multiday tournament of BANANAGRAMS for the third time in a row! Join other word scrambling enthusiasts and work your way up the brackets over 3 days of JoCo to finally reach your lifelong goal of being crowned master of all things Bananagram! If you’ve never played the game before, Bananagrams is an easy game to learn—all are welcome! Prizes will be given to winners! Prizes will also probably be given to non winners as well!

name: Lunar Skyline - Double-Suited Trick-Taking Game Demo
description: Build the first lunar metropolis in Lunar Skyline! A double-suited trick-taking game of high-stakes bidding where every trick secures resources and lucrative bonus contracts.

name: Needle Felting - Painting with Wool
description: We will demonstrate needle felting, a type of embroidery. It is a craft that uses a steel needle to attach small pieces of wool to a cloth substrate to make art. Basic technique will be shown and participants will be able to create a 2-color JoCo logo on a piece of t-shirt fabric. Bring your own t-shirt if you wish to directly embellish one; otherwise, all material provided.

name: Be the First to See My Movie! SNEAK PEAK of Vidhya's Guide to the Afterlife & Q&A w/Sandeep Parikh
description:
Friends: I directed a film starring Dropout's Rekha Shankar last year, thanks in large part to many of you on this boat who helped us raise $250,000 on Kickstarter! And I want to show you exclusive, never-before-seen clips and invite you into the filmmaking process! Making a sci-fi indie dramedy film with South Asian leads, focusing on our lives as sons & daughters of immigrants, has been life-changing, and I want to gab with you all about it. Here's what the flick is about-

VIDHYA'S GUIDE TO THE AFTERLIFE
When chef Vidhya Ramachandran returns home to Philadelphia for her grandmother's funeral, she witnesses a "Hindu Rapture"—an unprecedented event where Hindus worldwide vanish in a colorful flash. But for some godforsaken reason, Vidhya is left behind.

As the "Last Hindu on Earth," Vidhya faces the crushing realization that she doesn't fully understand her place in her own culture. Desperate to get her family back, she teams up with Naathan (Dhruv Uday Singh), a charming but mysterious Hindu priest left behind to shepherd lost souls. Together, they embark on a weird, hilarious and heart wrenching journey to hack the afterlife.

Have YOU ever wanted to make a movie? Or understand what all those names in the long scroll of credits actually do? Or what the challenges (and opportunities) we face as artists around AI? Or just what shenanigans happen between takes? Or what's Rekha's weirdest acting tic? Well I'll spill all the beans, share this incredible journey, and hopefully inspire you to get out there and tell your own stories!

name: Learn and dance West Coast Swing!
description: West Coast Swing (WCS) is a partner dance, characterized by dancing in a linear "slot" on the floor. The first hour we'll teach the basics of West Coast Swing, and the second hour we'll dance! No prior experience or partner required --- we will rotate partners frequently.

name: Time Travel in Science and Literature
description: Is time travel possible? How have people imagined it? How might the physics work? In this glimpse of my course for first-year college students of all backgrounds, you'll learn to describe relativity using "spacetime diagrams" and discuss a short story together.

name: Irish instrumental session

name: Genre Mashing for Fun and Penguins
description:
Is your star command a little bland? Your magical tale kind of stale? Whether your worlds are full of magic, technology, demons, or wuxia cultivators, sometimes mixing things up can open new possibilities, introduce new perspectives—or it can just be fun.

Let's dip our metaphorical toes into the unclassifiable chaos of genre mashing—writing stories with characters and worlds that should have nothing to do with each other.

This workshop is for anyone who writes, wants to write, or just wants to try something new. Please bring pens, notebooks, crayons, laptops—whatever you use to write. There will be writing and sharing and laughter—and maybe even a little learning. And yes, our final writing prompt will invoke penguins.

description: Make a paper charm and attempt to draw your name in Egyptian hieroglyphs on it, or a different word if you prefer. Reference a collection of English sounds and phonemes in hieroglyphs, examples, or a dictionary. Some info on the language and a translation activity also provided!

name: Being Trans in 2026 America
description:
Suggestions, Tips, Tricks, Referrals, U.S. state comparisons, foreign country options, then Q&A

A heartfelt (& heart-full ♥️) welcome to all of our trans and gender-diverse cruisers!

I was curious if any of us might like to have an informal get together and talk about the current challenges in each of our states, tips you may have picked up on how best to stay safe when in "hostile territory", or if there's anything one or more of us needs desperately that another one of us might be able to assist with.

Let's chat!
